normative_constraints: Canonical bytes are UTF-8 compact sorted-key JSON without LF or self hash; serialized build <=8192 bytes.

application_source_inventory_sha256 is SHA-256 of the canonical compact UTF-8 JSON mapping every sorted tracked applications path to its locally recomputed lowercase SHA-256 digest; no caller-supplied inventory or root is trusted.

Reconstruct the complete applications inventory from exact clean executable checkout; reject missing, changed, unreadable, symlink-substituted or untracked executable paths. Preserve the existing 8192-byte source inventory work bound.
backend_source_inventory_sha256 retains v1 meaning and is independently reconstructed from the complete tracked backend inventory.
public_module_sha256 retains the exact five paths and locally recomputed byte digests. Lock bytes, every installed locked distribution version and exact CPython patch version remain bound.
contract_source_sha256 has exactly the eight paths named by the v2 decision amendment; policy_file_sha256 and canonical limit_policy_sha256 remain bound. Numerical policy values do not change.

Dispatch strictly by schema edition. v1 validates only the frozen v1 full-map form; v2 validates only this root form. Unknown and cross-edition witnesses refuse. Historical v1 computational replay requires the matching v1 checkout/environment.
Commit label alone is insufficient; the current source, inventory, policy, contracts, interpreter and dependencies are all recomputed. Synthetic builds do not establish executable identity.
